turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: Okay. Claude Ship. Let's actually explain what this is, because the name does not tell you.

turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: The name sounds like a logistics startup that failed in 2019.

turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: Heh. So — Anthropic released this on November twenty-third. It's a suite of three AI agents built specifically around GitHub pull requests. Code Review is generally available. PR Steward and Claude Approvals are both in beta.

turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: And the distinction between those three matters enormously.

turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: Code Review analyses your code — that's the familiar part, AI as reader. PR Steward goes one step further: it handles merge conflicts, pushes fixes, responds to feedback. But it cannot actually approve a merge.
